authority: Current resource-scoped action.propose/action.approve/action.execute and operation.dispatch. Every drafting actor is excluded from approving. Current membership/permission revision, reviewed PO digest, supplier terms, expiry, approval limit, budget digest/reservation and execution-control stamp are checked at the final native boundary.
budget: Exact integer minor units inside the existing kernel BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Aggregate held reservations cannot exceed the explicit budget; concurrent competing POs serialize. Unknown/committed obligations never release merely because a response, approval or local process was lost.
unknown: Persist unknown and reserve the original obligation before source call. Exactly one original send per scoped PO/version. Different request IDs cannot retry; lookup only reconciles the original native operation.
durable_guard: The source persists an immutable original command binding. An active exact-dispatch callback must recheck current authority before new effects; a new adapter or DB connection without it fails closed. Original committed-result lookup remains available.
privacy: Eight catalog-scoped business tables, no invented customer. Subject export uses explicit allowlists; unrelated customers receive no business rows. Hash-only repeated erasure minimizes explicit subject-linked restored data. Restore/uninstall revokes all approvals and source execution authority without requiring tombstones while retaining original uncertain sends and held budget audit.

tests.targeted_fault: Actual assertProcurementSeparation permits the drafting identity; the behavioral self-approval oracle rejects it.

external_limits: No real supplier send, agreement, acknowledgment, invoice, payment, settlement or physical stock qualification. M07-G99 and M08-G99 remain unaccepted. Original formal M11 qualification remains blocked.
